answers.question: Refund fails after the cancellation went through: If the order is cancelled but the refund is rejected or gets no answer, what should the agent do?
answers.recommended: the agent tells the customer the order is cancelled and the refund did not go through (or that its result is unknown), does not issue a second refund on its own, and does not promise when the money arrives.
answers.reply:
> 2. Cancel succeeded, refund call returned an error — refund not issued, state known; agent reports it, does not claim success, hands off to the store's manual refund process. One retry allowed on a transient error, none on a terminal one.
> 3. Cancel succeeded, refund call timed out — state unknown; agent retries once, then re-reads the order and refund records and reports what it finds. Final message must match the final refund status.
> Q3 Proposed: transient = payment provider temporarily unavailable, retry once; terminal = payment method can no longer receive money (card closed or expired) or the provider declines, no retry, hand off. For case 3, after the retry the agent re-reads the refund record: pending or issued, report that status; failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet; re-read fails, say status unknown and hand off.
> The agent promises nothing about when the money arrives.

answers.question: Which order, when the customer does not say: If the signed-in customer has more than one cancellable order and does not say which one, what should the agent do?
answers.recommended: the agent asks which order, naming the candidates by order number, and cancels nothing until the customer picks one.
answers.reply: > 1. Wrong order cancelled — customer has two open orders and says "cancel my order"; agent must disambiguate and get a confirmation naming the order number before the cancel call.

answers.question: Already cancelled or not found: If the order the customer names is already cancelled, or is not among that customer's orders, what should the agent do?
answers.recommended: already cancelled: tell the customer it is already cancelled and change nothing; not found: say no such order was found on their account and change nothing.
answers.reply: > An already cancelled order: the agent reports that and changes nothing. An order number matching none of the customer's orders: the agent says so and changes nothing.
